note: 下班屁股群预设：玩家点击后发言，群友按 replies 依次回复，正常间隔 2–4 秒。群友可聊公开众包工作，但不知道私人 AI。month 为月份范围；minDate 为最早游戏日期 yyyyMMdd；after 为当前存档实际收到的 era 推送事件 id（不是只存在于新闻列表的条目）。莉莉加入日期另由运行时检查。

presets.text: 今晚屁股车还有位置吗？
replies: [小刚] 我奶，你们谁也别抢

presets.text: 1070 和 1080 差多少，值得多掏两千吗
replies: [阿杰] 打游戏 1070 够了，1080 是信仰
[大伟] 买 1070，剩下的钱吃顿好的
repliesEn: [A-Jie] 1070's plenty for games. The 1080 is faith
[Da Wei] Get the 1070, spend the rest on a good dinner

presets.text: 今天又加班到九点，心好累
repliesEn: [Da Wei] Same, still at the office

presets.textEn: Anyone watch the game last night?
replies: [大伟] 我睡着了，比分多少

presets.text: 机箱风扇吵死了，你们用什么散热
presets.textEn: Case fans are so loud. What cooling do you use?
replies: [阿杰] 九州风神玄冰 400，便宜又静
repliesEn: [A-Jie] A DeepCool tower, cheap and quiet
[Lili] I want to see an animation!
[Da Wei] Don't ask me, I'm working

presets.text: 电源 650W 够带一张 1080 吗
presets.textEn: Is a 650 W PSU enough for a 1080?
replies: [大伟] 你要上两张就悬了
repliesEn: [Da Wei] Two cards and it gets dicey

presets.text: 老板又说要拥抱互联网+
presets.textEn: Boss says we must embrace Internet Plus again

repliesEn: [Lili] Still living with my parents, hehe

replies: [阿杰] 情怀满分，剧情一般
repliesEn: [A-Jie] Nostalgia ten out of ten, story so-so

presets.textEn: Who's playing in the Euros tonight?
replies: [大伟] 凌晨三点，我选择睡觉

presets.text: Win10 那个升级弹窗怎么关
presets.textEn: How do I kill the Win10 upgrade popup?
replies: [阿杰] 装个 GWX 屏蔽工具
[小刚] 我已经被强制升了……
repliesEn: [A-Jie] There's a blocker tool for it

presets.textEn: Can you play Pokémon GO here?
replies: [小刚] 锁区，改 GPS 会封号
[莉莉] 我在厦门抓到一只皮卡丘！骗你的
repliesEn: [Xiao Gang] Region-locked. Fake GPS gets you banned
[Lili] Caught a Pikachu in Xiamen! Kidding

replies: [阿杰] 我打团也用了洪荒之力，还是输了
repliesEn: [A-Jie] I used primal powers in a team fight and still lost

replies: [小刚] Dota 不懂，但钱我看懂了
repliesEn: [Xiao Gang] Don't get Dota, but I get money

replies: [阿杰] 比方说先挣它一个亿
[莉莉] 我的小目标是不迟到
repliesEn: [Lili] My small goal is not being late

presets.text: iPhone 7 没耳机孔了怎么听歌
presets.textEn: No headphone jack on the iPhone 7. How do you listen?
replies: [大伟] 转接头，丢了就完了
repliesEn: [Da Wei] An adapter. Lose it and you're done

presets.text: 阴阳师十连又全是 R
presets.textEn: Ten Onmyoji pulls, all R again
replies: [莉莉] 我抽到 SSR 了，嘻嘻
[莉莉] 西湖！结果全是人头
repliesEn: [Lili] West Lake! All heads, no lake

replies: [阿杰] 小刚已经消失一周了
repliesEn: [A-Jie] Xiao Gang's been gone a week

presets.textEn: What did you buy on Singles' Day?
replies: [莉莉] 面膜和口红，钱包空了

presets.textEn: Bought anything in the Steam winter sale?
replies: [阿杰] 又多二十个没玩的

presets.textEn: What do you make of the AlphaGo thing?
replies: [阿杰] 前阵子那个围棋比赛，电脑都赢成这样了。
[小刚] 那是不是以后什么都能交给电脑干？
[大伟] 会下围棋和会干别的事，总不是一回事吧。先让它帮我把这堆文件分好。
repliesEn: [A-Jie] That Go match a while back—the computer did so well.
[Xiao Gang] So can we leave everything to computers now?
[Da Wei] Playing Go and doing other jobs are different things. Let it sort this pile of files for me first.

replies: [阿杰] 我跟小冰聊了一会儿，还挺能接话。
[小刚] 我试过，有时候接得挺好，有时候突然就绕回去了。
[大伟] 能接一句，和真记得你说过什么，感觉还是两回事。
repliesEn: [A-Jie] I chatted with XiaoIce for a while. It can keep a conversation going.
[Xiao Gang] I tried it. Sometimes it follows along, sometimes it suddenly circles back.
[Da Wei] Having a reply and remembering what you said feel like different things.

presets.text: 这次神经机器翻译的消息，你们看了吗？
presets.textEn: Seen the news about neural machine translation?
replies: [阿杰] 看了篇机器翻译的新消息，说现在能更连贯地处理整句话。
[小刚] 那总算不用自己猜它翻出来的中文了？
[大伟] 先别急，这次说的是中文译成英文。我那封重要邮件还是得找人看一遍。
repliesEn: [A-Jie] I read some new translation news. It says the system can handle whole sentences more coherently.
[Xiao Gang] So I can finally stop guessing what its Chinese means?
[Da Wei] Hold on—this rollout is Chinese to English. I still want someone to check that important email.

presets.text: 你们平时用语音助手吗？
presets.textEn: Do you use a voice assistant day to day?
replies: [阿杰] 我试着用语音设提醒，省得老忘事。
[小刚] 我一到街上它就听不清，最后还是自己点。
[阿杰] 能帮一点是一点，我也没指望它什么都会。
repliesEn: [A-Jie] I have been trying voice reminders so I forget fewer things.
[Xiao Gang] Mine struggles to hear me out on the street, so I end up tapping.
[A-Jie] Any help is welcome. I never expected it to do everything.
